title: Veylqorix — No Unsafe Code Gets Through
description: Veylqorix is a universal code-security and quality platform that verifies AI-generated and human-written code before it ships. The build story, changelog, and a full tour of the platform.

headings.text: Verify the code your agents wrote. Before it ships.
The full story, in three places

sections.heading: Verify the code your agents wrote. Before it ships.
sections.text: NO UNSAFE CODE GETS THROUGH SHOWCASE Verify the code your agents wrote. Before it ships. Veylqorix independently verifies AI-generated and human-written code before it is committed, pushed, merged, or deployed. It orchestrates real scanners — dependency auditing, secret detection, license checks, static analysis, and test suites — normalizes their output into one finding schema, and turns it into a deterministic gate decision with auditable evidence. Read the build story See the changelog VEYLQORIX / GATE-DECISION (ILLUSTRATIVE) VEYLQORIX $ veylqorix scan . --json 23 findings · 2 critical · 5

sections.heading: Four guarantees
sections.text: WHY VEYLQORIX Four guarantees AI coding agents now write a large share of production code — fast, plausible, and occasionally unsafe. Lint and CI pipelines were not designed to verify that volume. Veylqorix fills the gap: GUARANTEE 01 Real evidence, no fabrication Every finding, severity, and exit code comes from an actual scanner run. A check that cannot run is reported SKIPPED or ERROR with a reason — never a clean pass. sections.heading: Where Veylqorix plugs in
sections.text: ONE ENGINE, MANY SURFACES Where Veylqorix plugs in Every surface is a thin adapter over the same core engine (packages/core), so there is exactly one place where security logic lives: CLI 01 Real scans, deterministic exit codes, safe dry-run hook installer. Not published to npm yet — run from dist/. MCP SERVER 02 Six validated tools, root-confinement + redaction. Requires pnpm build. GITHUB ACTIONS GATE 03 Real scan + SARIF upload, all actions pinned to SHAs. Advisory until a branch-protection rule requires the check. sections.heading: Scanner adapters reuse real tools
sections.text: HOW IT WORKS Scanner adapters reuse real tools SCANNER BACKED BY OFFLINE? Dependencies npm audit (Node) / pip-audit (Python) optional Secrets Rust engine secret scanner (offline, 9 families) — TypeScript fallback, redacted values yes Licenses manifest-level license checks, copyleft risk yes Quality tsc, eslint, ruff, project test scripts no System architecture — entry points reach one core engine; results fan out to CLI, API, and CI surfaces. Scan lifecycle — normalize before judging, gate failures are first-class, verify don't trust.

sections.heading: What Veylqorix is not
sections.text: HONEST LIMITATIONS What Veylqorix is not READ THIS FIRST Veylqorix reports what its scanners found. It does not certify the absence of vulnerabilities or secrets. A scanner that cannot run makes the gate INCOMPLETE (exit 2) — degraded coverage is surfaced, never green-washed. Regex secret detection has false positives and negatives; it complements tools like Gitleaks, it does not replace them. License scanning is manifest-level, not a transitive license audit.
